constraints_and_local_discretion: Read-only: do not edit, stage, commit, push, comment on GitHub, run servers, browsers or package scripts. The repository CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md describe the host/coordinator, not you.

Verdict rules: PASS = no important findings and every acceptance criterion met by code inspection and/or the cited host/CI evidence. FAIL = at least one important finding (a concrete defect or unmet criterion). BLOCKED only if you cannot read the inputs. Do NOT return BLOCKED merely because you could not run a browser yourself: judge browser criteria from the code plus the host evidence file, and if you doubt that evidence, name the exact extra check the host should run.

Review for correctness: focus trap edge cases (focus outside overlay, 0 or 1 focusable, ordering vs the Escape and HTMLInputElement checks, feature detection, Shift+Tab, altKey, overlay selector vs the JSX, the TOC overlay's click-to-close wrapper), and the flip wrapper (settings restored on throw, any other synchronous reader of disableFlipByClick, interaction with the existing isPointOnCorners/showCorner/stopMove patches, swipes, turnToPage/flip(page) paths, why 4788bea removed it and whether that still holds).
Check that tests assert requirements rather than transcribe the implementation; flag missing cases that matter. Check scope: only web/src/Viewer.tsx, book.ts, book.test.ts; no new deps.

Report only actionable findings with file:line and a concrete failure scenario; mark pre-existing issues as pre_existing (they do not fail the review). Viewer.tsx is 305 lines (300 is a review signal, not a limit).

Repair-specific questions: is getDirectionByPoint read anywhere outside the synchronous flipNext/flipPrev call (e.g. during animation, fold, hover, swipe end), so that the temporary override could leak or be missed? Are FlipDirection numeric values 0=FORWARD/1=BACK correct for the installed page-flip build? Is the override restored on throw? Does checkDirection or first/last page handling still work? Is the comment accurate?
stop_conditions: you would need to write anything to decide
deliverable: Final message only (no files): a block starting with the line `REVIEW_BEGIN` and ending with `REVIEW_END`, containing: verdict PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED, reviewed_revision, findings [severity important|nit|pre_existing, file:line, summary, failure_scenario], criteria_check (each acceptance criterion -> met/unmet/unverifiable + evidence), checks_run with results. After REVIEW_END print exactly: `REPORT RESULT_SUBMITTED review` (or `REPORT BLOCKED review`).
